summary: V3 backend testing on https://nda-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api — 80/82 tests passed (97.6%), 2 intentional skips for legacy voice/sign tests now superseded by real-Whisper coverage. NEW V3 coverage (17/17 PASS in test_v3_endpoints.py): (1) POST /auth/google/session → invalid session correctly returns 401, (2) POST /auth/face/enroll rejects no-face image with 400 + accepts real StyleGAN face from thispersondoesnotexist.com returning enrolled:true, (3) GET /auth/face/status returns enrolled:true after enroll, (4) POST /documents/face-verify with REAL Haar detection — rejects blank image with 400 'No face detected' AND verifies with a real face (returns verified:true + distance), auto-enrolls on first call, (5) POST /documents/voice-oath with garbage audio returns 400 with structured 'similarity' field (real Whisper STT round-trip works — got transcription-error response gracefully, NOT 500), (6) POST /documents secure mode WITHOUT recipient_email → 400 'Recipient email is required' (normal mode still succeeds without email; secure WITH email succeeds), (7) GET /file-tools/formats returns inputs+outputs lists including pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx/txt/md/jpg/png/webp, (8) POST /file-tools/compress-image quality=40 → content-type image/jpeg + X-Original-Size & X-Compressed-Size headers, compressed (~6KB) is much smaller than original (~470KB JPEG random), (9) POST /file-tools/compress-pdf → application/pdf with %PDF magic bytes, (10) POST /file-tools/convert DOCX→PDF, TXT→PDF, JPG→PDF all return valid %PDF + correct X-Detected-Format header, (11) PDF→DOCX uses pdf2docx (verified in backend logs: 'Start to convert ... [1/4] Opening document') and returns valid wordprocessingml zip (PK header). REGRESSION (63/65 PASS, 2 skips): all auth/signup/login, magic-link request+consume+expiry, upload+PDF parse, document CRUD/lifecycle with OTP+face+signature gates, AI generate/review/chat (multi-turn with PDF context + ACTION_JSON detection), chat sessions+history+action send_pdf_email (Resend test-mode account-holder sent:true / others sent:false gracefully), preferences (dark_mode + tier), signed-pdf + audit-pdf download (header auth + ?token= query on audit). Real face image fetched at runtime from thispersondoesnotexist.com (StyleGAN) and Haar-detected locally; tests skip gracefully if upstream unreachable.

minor.issue: Still uses get_current_user only — does NOT accept ?token= query param (carryover from iteration 2). audit-pdf sibling correctly supports it. Recommend swapping to get_user_from_query_or_header for in-app Linking.openURL viewing.
Invalid tier values silently dropped (carryover from iteration 2). Recommend HTTP 400 with explicit error.
Real Whisper STT correctly rejects bogus audio with 400, but error message embeds raw Whisper response (e.g. '[transcription error 400: ...]') — consider sanitizing for production.

Uses simple 256-bit perceptual hash over 16x16 grayscale face crop with threshold=90 Hamming. Adequate for liveness/anti-replay deterrent but NOT spoof-resistant. Acceptable for V3 demo; flag for future ML upgrade.

action_items: (Carryover) Return 400 on invalid tier in PATCH /auth/prefs.
Sanitize Whisper error responses bubbled up from /documents/voice-oath (don't leak upstream status text).
Consider word-boundary regex for AI-flag heuristics in POST /documents (still flags 'function' as Source code).
Future: upgrade face_match from perceptual hash to a real face embedding (insightface/face_recognition) for stronger anti-spoof.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1043 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Split into routers/ (auth, ai, chat, documents, files, biometrics) before next feature addition.
face_match.compute_face_hash returns '' on no-face, hamming() returns 1_000_000 sentinel — works but use Optional[str] / None for clarity.
voice_match.transcribe_and_match catches *all* exceptions returning (False, 0.0, '[error]') — good for resiliency but masks real network/auth issues. Add structured logging.
file_tools._image_bytes_to_pdf uses PIL's PDF save (single-page only, no layout). OK for simple JPG/PNG inputs.
file_tools.compress_pdf only re-flows content streams (pypdf), images inside are NOT re-encoded — for photo-heavy PDFs compression will be minimal.
pdf2docx Converter logs to root logger (INFO) directly — noisy backend logs; wrap with logging.getLogger override.
face_image_b64 stored truncated to 500k chars — base64 of 512x512 JPEG quality 85 is ~50-100k, safe headroom.
JWT_SECRET still defaults to 'bachein-secret-key-change-in-production-2026' if env missing — rotate before prod.
